title: deparia pachyphylla
intro: Deparia pachyphylla, commonly known as the Asian polypody fern, is a type of plant species in the family Athyriaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Deparia pachyphylla are attributed to its ability to regulate blood circulation and reduce oxidative stress, with potential applications in the treatment of cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases. The bioactive constituents of Deparia pachyphylla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
